scope: All benchmark attempts and observer setup attempts; no timing outliers removed
classification_policy: 200 ms nominal snapshots; all named compiler/tool processes count. Available command lines identify build orchestration. Unresolved shells are retried and block if still unresolved after 1000 ms; shorter unresolved launches remain explicit observation limitations.
